name: junco-tools
description: Pi bash operations backed by marsh ShellMux

scripts.build:native: bun run grammars && node scripts/with-junco-build-env.mjs napi build --platform --release --esm --output-dir native --js index.js --dts index.d.ts -- --locked
scripts.build:native:test: bun run grammars && node scripts/with-junco-build-env.mjs napi build --platform --esm --features test-fs --output-dir target/native-test --js index.js --dts index.d.ts -- --locked
scripts.build: bun run build:native && bun run build:ts
scripts.test: timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 900s node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/shell-mux.test.mjs tests/bash.test.mjs tests/agent.test.mjs tests/tools.test.mjs tests/task.test.mjs tests/complain.test.mjs tests/messaging.test.mjs tests/profile-tools.test.mjs tests/usage-limits.test.mjs
